For fleet owners

EV Scope works out the battery size, the charger size and the grid connection for your vehicles, from the routes they drive.

Questions it answers
How much battery do our vehicles actually need?
Will they still finish a winter shift at year 8?
Do we have to upgrade the grid connection?
Example

Six refuse trucks on a 120 km city round with 400 stops. Each needs a 370 kWh battery. The depot peaks at 166 kW, inside the 400 kW it already has.

Sample case with illustrative figures. Open this case in the demo
